## Data Flow

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
subgraph station[Station]
  id_cam@{shape: procs, label: "Cameras"} --> id_transfer_adapter@{shape: procs, label: "Transfer Adapters"}
  id_transfer_adapter -->|FlowFiles| id_station_nifi[Station NiFi]

  id_telem@{shape: procs, label: "Telemetry / Logs / Health Sources"} --> id_otel_collect[OTel Collector]
  id_otel_collect --> id_otel_batch[ListenOTLP]
  id_otel_collect --> id_local_observability_store[On-Station Observability Store]
  id_otel_batch --> id_station_nifi
end

subgraph hq_dms[HQ    DMS]
  id_dms_nifi[DMS NiFi]
  id_dms_proc[...]
  id_dms_nifi --> id_dms_proc
end

subgraph hq_ocs[HQ OCS]
  id_ocs_nifi[OCS NiFi]
  id_central_observability_store[Central Observability Store]
  id_ocs_nifi --> id_central_observability_store
end

subgraph swpc[SWPC]
  id_swpc[SWPC]
end

id_station_nifi -->|Science image / data files| id_dms_nifi
id_station_nifi -->|Telemetry / log / health batches| id_ocs_nifi
id_dms_proc --> id_swpc
```
